description.value:
You toss the required locus to a point in range, imbuing the optic tool with a connection to your own vision. For the duration, the locus can see in all directions with your normal visual senses, though it treats sight as an imprecise sense past 15 feet. You can Sustain the spell to switch between seeing through the locus or through your standard vision.

Heightened (+1) The duration of the spell is increased by 5 minutes, and the range past which the locus's sight becomes imprecise is increased by 5 feet.

system.requirements: You have a scope, goggles, or some other optical tool, used as a locus.
